# Our Premium Features

View a list of features you can access with a BotGhost Premium subscription.

With a Premium Subscription you can access many exclusive BotGhost features, including removed limits, customized branding, and unlocked modules. These features will allow you to customize your bot with great potential and possibility. Below you can find information about some of these exclusive features.

## General Bot Features

| Feature                                                 |                   Free                  |                         Premium                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------: | :-----------------------------------------------------: |
| Create Unlimited Bots                                   |                    1                    |         <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark>         |
| Servers                                                 |             Up to 5 servers             | <mark style="color:green;">**Unlimited servers**</mark> |
| 24/7 Hosting                                            | <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark> |         <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark>         |
| [Beta Features Access](/premium/beta-features.md)       |                    ❌                    |         <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark>         |
| [Collab](/general-settings-and-collaboration/collab.md) | <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark> |         <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark>         |
| [Status](/general-settings-and-collaboration/status.md) |                    ❌                    |         <mark style="color:green;">**✔**</mark>         |
